verdict.rationale: Gusto is a payroll/HR platform, not an AI agent or assistant interface; there's no evidence of a Gusto-side agent that could act as an MCP client and plug in external MCP servers. The only MCP-related evidence is the reverse direction — Gusto's own Embedded Dev Assistant MCP server for external AI tools (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop) to consume, which is a different axis than 'plugging MCP servers into Gusto'.
